# Support Handbook

This handbook describes how the support team handles common requests.

## Refunds

Standard refunds are available for thirty days from the delivery date. Enterprise
agreements may specify a different window, which always takes precedence over this
default.

### Exceptions

Final sale items and custom fabrication orders cannot be refunded once production has
started.

## Escalation

Escalate to the account team when a customer disputes a charge above ten thousand
dollars, or when a contract term conflicts with standard policy.
